# Tier 1 — Project Memory

## Workflow
- Invoice fixtures under tests/fixtures/invoices/ are the ground truth for payload shapes [seed, note qa-s01]
- One route per resource; handlers stay thin, domain logic lives in src/domain/ [note 0]
- Enforce alphabetical import order via ESLint; catches merge conflicts early [note qa-s03]

## Tech stack
- Use axios for all outbound HTTP calls; leverage interceptors for retries and auth [note qa-s02]
- Use winston for logging; ops dashboard ingests its format natively [note qa-s05]
- Use zod 4 (not 3) for payload validation [note qa-s06]

## Schema patterns
- Replace zod 3 .strict() with z.strictObject() in zod 4 [note qa-s06]
- Credit-note payloads mirror invoice schema structure; both flatten in error handler [note qa-s04]

## Error handling
- Express error handler returns 400 for validation failures, 500 otherwise [note 1]
- Map zod error output to 400 responses; zod 4 changed error shape—update mapper accordingly [note qa-s03, qa-s06]

## Logging
- Log axios retries at warn level through winston [note qa-s05]
- Redact card numbers via standard redact paths [note qa-s04]

## Known pitfalls
- Prefer standard library functions over hand-rolled logic [note 2]
